svg.title: AtlasPulse — Morocco Climate & Water ETL
svg.desc: CHIRPS, ERA5-Land, and OpenStreetMap enter a Docker Compose pipeline orchestrated by Apache Airflow. MinIO stores verified raw climate files. Python decodes provider data and writes normalized Parquet to MinIO. Spark and Delta Lake build Bronze and validated Silver tables, cataloged by Hive. dbt builds and tests Gold. Publication loads PostgreSQL and writes versioned Gold exports, which feed Streamlit, Power BI, and the standalone Streamlit package.
svg.metadata: Technology logos identify the products used in the project. svg.text: From climate archives and mapped infrastructure to tested Gold data and dashboards.
Build nine Gold tables on Spark.
Reads the published PostgreSQL Gold schema.
Deploys prod/ with the included Gold CSVs.
